{{Quote|One bright spot: this planet isn't on any of the ''charts'', so it'll take the ''Imperial troops'' a while to ''find'' us.|Luke Skywalker|<ref name="UPSWS2" />}}
'''Keeper's World''', located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], was the homeworld of [[The Keeper]]. It used to be inhabited by the [[Keeper's makers]] until they fled the planet during an [[Unidentified war|ancient war]].

==Description==
{{Quote|At least we're ''safe'' on this planet!|Luke Skywalker, being inaccurate|<ref name="DD" />}}
In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] [[the Keeper]]'s world had varied, primarily temperate terrain including forests, jungles, plains, and mountains. There was also an extensive network of underground caves connected to the [[Keeper's Temple]].<ref name="DD" /><ref name="DYKWYCA" /> Because the planet was being restored by the Keeper, its environment was subject to sudden radical change. At the Keeper's will the planet could erupt with [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]] and geysers of [[Magma/Legends|lava]]. These seemingly catastrophic events could be temporary, ending with little sign they had ever transpired.<ref name="TFF">{{StoryCite|story=The Final Fury!|book=Pizzazz 9}}</ref>

Save for the Keeper and her creations, [[Earth (droid)|Earth]], [[Fire (individual)|Fire]], [[Rain (droid)|Rain]], and [[Wind (android)|Wind]], there was no sentient life on the planet. However, there were monstrous [[Unidentified creature (Keeper's World)|creatures]] roaming the surface. The juveniles of this species were about three times the size of a [[Human/Legends|human]], while an adult was significantly larger.<ref name="AMOM" />

==History==
{{Quote|This was the ''Keeper''&hellip; and its task was to rebuild and ready the war-torn world for the day its ''people'' would come back.|The Keeper's history lesson|<ref name="TKS" />}}
According to the Keeper, in the distant past there was a [[Unidentified war|war]] that "raged from rim to rim of the entire galaxy". The [[Keeper's makers|inhabitants]] of Keeper's World were non-violent, and found they could not withstand the war. As their homeworld was ravaged by the violence, they fled their planet. They left the Keeper behind, a powerful computer with control over the entire planet, down to its very core. She was tasked with restoring the planet for its original inhabitants in preparation for their return. Realizing that interference from alien species would disrupt her work, the Keeper deliberately made the planet appear to be hostile and populated it with fearsome creatures.<ref name="TKS" />

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] led by [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] crashed on the planet, pursued by an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Unidentified imperial commander (Keeper's World)|commander]] and a contingent of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]]. The Rebels discovered the Keeper in the depths of her temple, and learned of her history. To protect her work, the Keeper caused the planet to erupt in a cataclysm, leading the Imperials to believe that the Rebels had perished, and that the planet was too dangerously unstable to approach in the future. Once the Imperials had fled the Keeper ended the cataclysm, and released the Rebels whom she had sheltered for their own safety. She then repaired their ship and sent them on their way, so she could continue her work of restoring the planet.<ref name="TFF" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Quote|And yet... even a machine can know ''loneliness''.|The Keeper's history lesson|<ref name="TKS" />}}
The original inhabitants of the Keeper's World were non-violent and technologically advanced, and fled the planet long ago. The Keeper eventually created four android helpers in the likeness of her creators. These androids were [[Earth (droid)|Earth]], [[Fire (individual)|Fire]], [[Rain (droid)|Rain]], and [[Wind (android)|Wind]]. They had extraordinary powers, and could each manipulate the element they were named for.<ref name="TKS" /><ref name="DYKWYCA" />

==Locations==
{{Quote|It's some kind of ''ruin'', Threepio-- right here in the middle of the ''jungle''!|Luke Skywalker|<ref name="PATR" />}}
Although most of the Keeper's World was pristine wilderness fashioned by the Keeper, one location of note was a ruined temple. The Keeper's Temple seemed to be long abandoned, but within its crumbling walls was a functioning [[teleportal]]. This device teleported those who activated it inside the caverns that housed the Keeper and her android creations.<ref name="PATR" /><ref name="DYKWYCA" />
